title: G2.4 - Submission, DeliveryReview, and Acceptance
intent: Add immutable Submission candidates binding TargetRevision with artifact and verification sets, DeliveryReview by a reviewer independent of the submitter, and Acceptance reserved to the outcome owner, with derived invalidation when the target revision or submission changes.
scope: Implement the adjudication half of the trusted delivery loop: submissions, delivery reviews, acceptances as append-only facts with receipt+audit commands; read-model derived acceptance validity; Workbench Submission/Acceptance surfaces.
non_goals: Implement the GitHub Connector, CI IntegrationTask, or IntegrationRun (G2.5)
Fine-grained RBAC or group authority (G4); acceptance authority is the target revision outcome owner for now
Emit outbox events for adjudication aggregates; the Timeline reads tables directly
Approve, merge, deploy, release, or create a ship record without independent review and explicit user acceptance
acceptance_criteria: Submissions are immutable set snapshots: a submission binds target revision, artifact revision ids, verification result ids, submitter, and a submission hash; content changes require a new submission
Reviews are independent and append-only: a delivery review binds the submission with a verdict and unproven items; the reviewer principal must differ from the submitter

Acceptance requires an approved review and outcome-owner authority: acceptance binds the approved review and submission; only the outcome owner principal can accept; non-owner attempts are rejected with a forbidden error
Invalid acceptance is derived and visible: an acceptance over a superseded submission or a changed target revision renders as invalid in the read model without mutating the acceptance fact
Contracts synchronized and verified: migration reconcilable, Go integration tests cover the full adjudication path, facade and UI tests pass, i18n parity holds
